interface_changes: External-loop can omit a model factory and batch factory. The callable still receives (model, context), with model=None when no model source is supplied.

Model-less external-loop checkpoints store no model state or model digest. Resume validates that the checkpoint and current run agree on model-state presence; checkpoints containing weights still require a model.
implemented: Updated Rust input resolution, readiness requirements and run preparation so external-loop needs its loop entry but does not inherit independent model/batch requirements.
Updated Python dispatch and loop execution to import project loop modules without loading a model, invoke model-less loops, and report parameter-finiteness as not applicable when no model is present.
Added a dedicated CLI integration test covering formal external-loop training without model/batch, checkpoint creation and continuation by one additional step.

Zero-step external-loop trial now uses a first-class inconclusive worker/report status, retains structured zero-step evidence and exits with code 5; the same condition in formal train remains a failed run.
Human terminal output says the result is inconclusive rather than printing it as an execution error.
